modal.title: Keyboard Shortcuts
modal.description: Every keyboard shortcut available in the app

toggle-settings.label: Open settings
toggle-settings.description: Opens settings. Press again to close. Works anywhere in the workspace.

toggle-shortcuts.label: View keyboard shortcuts
toggle-shortcuts.description: Opens this list. Press again to close. Works anywhere in the workspace.

toggle-sidebar.label: Toggle sidebar
toggle-sidebar.description: Shows and hides the page sidebar. Works while you type too.

toggle-inbox.label: Toggle inbox
toggle-inbox.description: Opens and closes the inbox on the right. Works anywhere in the workspace.

search-for-documents.label: Open search
search-for-documents.description: Opens page search. Press again to close.

create-new-document.label: Create new page
create-new-document.description: Adds a new top level page. You stay on the page you are on.

add-params-to-split-doc.label: Add parameter list to split documentation
add-params-to-split-doc.description: Adds a parameter list to the left side of a split documentation block and puts your cursor in it. Works from anywhere in the block.

add-code-block-to-split-doc.label: Add code block to split documentation
add-code-block-to-split-doc.description: Adds a code block to the right side of a split documentation block and puts your cursor in its title. Works from anywhere in the block.

add-metrics-to-split-doc.label: Add metrics block to split documentation
add-metrics-to-split-doc.description: Adds a metrics block to the right side of a split documentation block. Your cursor does not move. Works from anywhere in the block.

add-diagram-to-split-doc.label: Add diagram to split documentation
add-diagram-to-split-doc.description: Adds a mermaid diagram to the right side of a split documentation block and puts your cursor in its source. Works from anywhere in the block.

undo.label: Undo
undo.description: Takes back your last change in the page.

redo.label: Redo
redo.description: Puts back the change you just undid.

inline-code.label: Inline code
inline-code.description: Shows the selected text as code.

heading-1.label: Heading 1
heading-1.description: Turns the line into a large heading. Press again to turn it back.

heading-2.label: Heading 2
heading-2.description: Turns the line into a medium heading. Press again to turn it back.

heading-3.label: Heading 3
heading-3.description: Turns the line into a small heading. Press again to turn it back.

bulleted-list.label: Bulleted list
bulleted-list.description: Turns the line into a bullet point. Press again to turn it back.

numbered-list.label: Numbered list
numbered-list.description: Turns the line into a numbered item. Press again to turn it back.

checklist.label: Checklist
checklist.description: Turns the line into a checkbox item. Press again to turn it back.

quote.label: Quote
quote.description: Turns the line into a quote. Press again to turn it back.

code-block.label: Code block
code-block.description: Turns the line into a code block. Press again to turn it back.

indent-list-item.label: Indent list item
indent-list-item.description: Moves the list item one level deeper. Works with the cursor in a list.

outdent-list-item.label: Outdent list item
outdent-list-item.description: Moves the list item one level up. Works with the cursor in a list.

exit-code-block.label: Leave code block
exit-code-block.description: Adds a new line below the code block and moves your cursor there. Works with the cursor in a code block or a Mermaid diagram.

md-bold.label: Bold
md-bold.description: Type it around a word to make it bold.

md-italic.label: Italic
md-italic.description: Type it around a word to make it italic. Underscores work too.

md-inline-code.label: Inline code
md-inline-code.description: Type it around a word to show it as code.

md-strikethrough.label: Strikethrough
md-strikethrough.description: Type it around a word to strike it through.

md-quote.label: Quote
md-quote.description: Type it at the start of a line to turn the line into a quote.

modal.markdown-block-hint: Type it at the start of a line.
modal.slash-hint: Type it at the start of a line, then pick the block from the menu.
